Mandeep Bhandari Appointed New CBSE Chairperson

Mandeep K Bhandari, an IAS officer, has been appointed as the new chairperson of the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). This appointment comes months after a re-evaluation row concerning the board. The appointment was part of a bureaucratic reshuffle by the Centre.
